subject: Approval needed: Orchard Systems - extended eval credits & timeline
messages:
From: Vikram Shah <vikram@orchard-systems.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Orchard Systems - ask for extra eval credits and extension

Markus,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier today. Procurement is still reviewing the security addendum and our legal team needs an extra 4–6 weeks before a PO can be issued. We are still very interested in Redwood — the team is impressed by the latency stats — but without extra runway the pilot will expire before we can demonstrate a full integration to the product team.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood add an additional 150,000 evaluation tokens (we used up most of the starter credits during ingestion and benchmarking)?
- Can you extend the POC window by 30 days (current end date 2026-09-05) to 2026-10-05?

If we get the runway and the additional credits we will prioritize the PO and target a signed order within 45 days after the extended trial. Happy to provide a signed commitment letter if that helps. I’ve attached our internal timeline (Orchard_POCTimeline.xlsx).

Regards,
Vikram Shah
Head of ML Engineering
Orchard Systems

Attachments: Orchard_POCTimeline.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Orchard Systems - ask for extra eval credits and extension

Team — forwarding Vikram’s request. Quick summary: Orchard (DF-3492) is asking for a 30-day extension + 150k eval tokens due to procurement delay. They commit to try to sign within 45 days after the extension.

Why this matters: Orchard is a strategic mid-market account (complex integration, high upsell potential into data platform) — losing momentum here would push us out of several RFPs they have in Q4.

My proposal (for approval routing):
- Option A (standard manager-level): approve a 60k token top-up + 30-day extension — covers immediate testing but still conservative on cost.
- Option B (exec approval required): approve up to 150k tokens + 30-day extension conditional on a signed commitment letter and a visible procurement timeline (PO or signed Doc).

I think option B materially increases our chance to convert; ask: Ben, can you prepare an impact calc? Laura, requesting exec sign-off if we think 150k is reasonable. Marissa, please confirm we can set the token grant to expire automatically after 30 days and enforce rate limits.

Forwarded message attached below.

— Markus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Orchard Systems - ask for extra eval credits and extension

Markus / team — I ran the numbers and sketched two options (attached):

- Conservative (manager sign-off): +60k tokens, 30-day extension. Estimated cost: $2.1k in token runrate for the period (based on their recent usage profile).
- Escalation (exec sign-off): +120k tokens, 30-day extension. Estimated cost: $4.2k runrate; this is less than the full 150k requested but gets Orchard enough runway to complete integration tests.

Notes and controls I recommend if we approve the escalation:
- Tokens issued as a one-time grant assigned to their account, expire automatically on 2026-10-05.
- Rate limits: cap throughput to the level we've agreed to in the existing trial (to avoid unexpected burst charges).
- Require a signed commitment letter or a clear procurement milestone (PO sent to sales@redwood.com) within 45 days of the extension or tokens are revoked.

Attachments: Orchard_Eval_Terms_v2.pdf, cost_impact_calc.xlsx, Orchard_MutualActionPlan.xlsx

If Laura is comfortable, I recommend approving the +120k (middle ground). Happy to take this to deal desk if you want a formal doc.

— Ben
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Orchard Systems - ask for extra eval credits and extension

Thanks for the clear write-ups. I approve a one-time grant of 120,000 evaluation tokens and a 30-day extension to 2026-10-05 under these conditions:

1) Orchard must provide either a signed commitment letter or PO to sales@redwood.com no later than 45 days from 2026-10-05 (i.e. by 2026-11-19).
2) The token grant will be time-limited and auto-revoked on 2026-10-06 if no PO/commitment is visible.
3) We require a short mutual action plan (MAP) — Ben/Marissa please upload the MAP to the HubSpot deal and share the Drive link back to the Orchard contacts.
4) If Orchard requests additional extension/credits after this window, we will revisit only after a signed commercial agreement is in place.

Markus — please communicate these conditions to Vikram and Claire, ask procurement to route a PO, and log the approval in Deal Desk (DF-3492). Ben — please implement the token grant with the expiry and rate limits. Marissa — coordinate the MAP and gating items.

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
